currentBehavior: The route invokes the Worker. It then calls the Cache API. Public auth bypass avoids customer KV and billing writes, but it does not bypass the Worker.

candidateDocumentedBehavior.authorizationRequestsBypass: Normally; explicit public/must-revalidate/s-maxage directives have documented exceptions. Public getBlock deliberately returns shared content.

acceptanceBeforeProduction: Keep cross-version caching off, so new deployments do not serve old reward or source-policy responses.
Verify all errors, profile variants, compact recovery, and client-locator variants return explicit no-store/private.
Verify query variations remain distinct and arbitrary representation headers use Vary if needed.
Check digest-complete streaming fills; prove an aborted/error stream is not reusable.
Compare CF-Cache-Status with platform invocation and CPU counters. A frozen X-Blockzilla-Cache header is insufficient.
Verify native identity and recovery pin behavior remains enforced for uncacheable compact requests.
Use the same Worker and existing source frames; do not upload rendered block copies.

alternativeIfZeroWorkerRequestFeeIsRequi.path: ordinary proxied hostname without Worker route -> normal zone cache -> existing machine streaming proxy -> current Worker on miss
alternativeIfZeroWorkerRequestFeeIsRequi.tradeoff: Adds an origin hop and machine bandwidth on misses. It requires routing changes and separate correctness/cost checks.
alternativeIfZeroWorkerRequestFeeIsRequi.r2CustomDomainAloneIsInsufficient: Existing epoch Compact V2 objects do not directly expose the generated per-slot JSON and Wincode responses.

streamErrorCacheCommitBehavior: Not explicitly documented; verify with a deliberate producer-stream error before activation.
